$Comment: Tomas the Miller's own small board: one job a day, drawn at midnight UTC. Hosts names the id Tomas keeps
in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Miller), so his quest page (Any work for me?, in his Christmas
conversation and in his feast conversation's Christmas line) lists the day's job beside his own quests,
and a player takes it, hands it in and collects its pay there or at this board.
The two slots are the two kinds of server. The first posts the Christmas_Miller_Skill band, which only
his skill job carries (Bounties/SeasonsOfOrbis/Mmo_Christmas_Miller_Skill_Job.json, a server running MMO
Skill Tree). The second posts the Christmas_Miller_Errand band, his plain errands. Each slot's Requires
is the plain hytale:mod_installed condition at its top level, read when the board loads: Min 1 leaves
the slot off the board where MMO Skill Tree is missing, and Max 0 leaves it off where that mod is
installed. So every server posts exactly one job from Tomas a day, for the same plain pay. Both slots
are Optional, so the slot a server leaves out never reads as a gap.
Grades names each band for the badge on its row: TitleKey is its words, Color the badge's colour.
Season makes the board absent while Christmas is off; a job left uncollected when Christmas ends shows
Collect in the player's Objective Book instead. Order 92 sorts it after Santa's board. Its words are in
